claims.claim: You can apply or do this online.
claims.quote: apply online on getyournec.scot – in all areas of Scotland
claims.note: The Scottish service explicitly offers online applications.

claims.claim: You can apply or do this in person.
claims.quote: After filling out your form you must take it, in person, to your nearest Translink bus or rail station
claims.note: The Northern Ireland service explicitly requires in-person submission.

claims.claim: Proof of age, such as a passport or birth certificate, is required.
claims.quote: Proof of age: driving licence (non-UK driving licences must contain your date of birth) passport (non-UK passports must contain your date of birth) birth certificate
claims.note: The Northern Ireland application names both passport and birth certificate as proof of age.
The Scottish application lists proof of current address.

claims.quote: along with a countersigned passport-sized photograph
claims.note: The Northern Ireland application requires a countersigned passport-sized photograph.
